text_en: The Nasdaq Golden Dragon China Index closed up 2.69% at 5,753.78 points, up 4.25% for the week. From October 5-8 it held steady near 5,600 points, opened higher on the 9th, significantly expanded gains in early trading, and then remained stable at a high level.
